correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 3×3 seed octahedral cycle using four ordered disjoint pairs of eight of nine bipartite edges; all 16 tetrahedral transversals avoid a perfect 3-matching. Fresh independent Python listed all 264 nonempty permitted faces; signed boundary of 16-term sphere vanishes. Independently checked six-supported integral degree-three cochain is closed on all 45 allowed 5-edge faces and pairs with sphere to +1, proving primitivity. Row/column transpositions each have signed chain traces (3,0,-8,-6,3,2), hence sign action on the rank-one H3 from published LSW Theorem 1.4. Uniform vertex-amalgamation maps to 3×3 preserve no-3-matching and pair Kronecker with root triples; the corresponding split surjection of free abelian H3 groups has equal rank by LSW, so it is an integral isomorphism. Contraction on ∧³Z^r and ∧³Z^s maps ordered triple classes to wedge² augmentation lattices; split kernels generated by four-term relations. Only the finite seed was enumerated; uniform r,s result uses the algebraic proof and the cited external rank theorem.

originality.rationale: Linusson–Shareshian–Welker state this hook-tensor representation as a conjecture for the general matching threshold and prove only nonequivariant wedge/rank; the k=3 integral lattice identification and explicit geometric basis are not supplied by that theorem. Holmsen–Lee study Leray bounds and homology vanishing, which do not determine this full integral group action. Published Resultary k=2 degree-bounded matching complexes are different from forbidding a matching of size 3.
residual_risks: The exact conjecture number differs between primary preprint versions (arXiv PDF shows 1.14, later text cites 1.15); cite version accurately at publication. Relies on published LSW rank theorem as an explicit external hypothesis, not re-proved. Hidden historical equivalent integral proof remains possible.
